primitives.note: Urchin Strike dash deals magic + 100% AD physical damage on landing if target still in range
Playful/Trickster splash magic damage lands after the dash/balance/hop sequence resolves
Playful (dash, balance ~0.75s, hop ~0.5s then splash) can be canceled early into Trickster (dash + immediate smaller splash), two separately timed resolution paths for the same base damage
Chum the Waters lure lands then the shark erupts for magic damage 2s later
the lure's travel distance before landing/attaching determines the Guppy/Chomper/Gigalodon damage tier (1.0x/1.25x/1.5x of the small-fish formula)
passive bleed applies on every basic attack hit, dealing DoT magic damage
passive bleed ticks every 0.5s over 3s, refreshing (not stacking) on subsequent hits
active arms the next basic attack with bonus magic damage plus a 5s on-hit buff window if the target survives
the empowered attack resets Fizz's basic attack timer
killing the target with the empowered attack refunds the mana cost and cuts the cooldown to 1s
mana costs (50 flat Q; 30-70 W; 75-95 E; 100 R) can meaningfully cap how often each ability is cast inside a 15s window without mana items/regen
Nimble Fighter's flat + %AP pre-mitigation damage reduction (capped 50%, higher vs monsters) only matters for damage taken, i.e. the survival fight

needsBespoke.why: All damage-relevant mechanics (dash-cast physical+magic hit, on-hit bleed DoT, empowered-attack with attack reset and kill-refund cooldown, a cancelable multi-part dash ability, and a travel-distance-gated projectile payload) map onto existing primitives; nothing requires logic outside the closed list for the damage fight.

unsettled.question: What travel distance should Chum the Waters be assumed to fly before landing/attaching in the dummy fight, since it directly sets the Guppy (1.0x)/Chomper (1.25x)/Gigalodon (1.5x) damage tier and the swing is large (e.g. rank 3: 420 to 630 base)?
options: Assume max range (>910 units) so it always attaches as a Gigalodon for maximum damage
Assume it is cast at/near the dummy (short travel) so it lands as a Guppy, the conservative default
Assume some fixed mid-range distance (Chomper tier) as a neutral default

unsettled.question: Does the automatic basic attack Fizz is ordered into immediately after Urchin Strike count as an extra scheduled attack in the rotation (triggering the W passive bleed, on-hit effects, and consuming the W empowered-attack buff if active), or is it just flavor text with no separate timing impact on the simulated attack sequence?
options: It is a real forced attack that fires right after the dash and should be scheduled as such, potentially consuming an active W empower
It only auto-issues an attack command if the player wasn't already attacking, so in an optimized sim it never adds an extra attack beyond the normal auto-attack cadence

unsettled.question: When Seastone Trident's active is triggered on a basic attack, does that same attack also apply/refresh the W passive bleed DoT (i.e., do both the active bonus damage and the passive bleed proc on one attack), or does the active override/replace the passive proc for that hit?
options: Both the active bonus damage and the passive bleed apply on the same empowered attack
The empowered attack only deals the active's bonus damage and does not also refresh/apply the passive bleed

proposal: Start at max rank on all abilities with full mana against the stationary dummy in melee/dash range.
Open with Q (Urchin Strike) to dash in, dealing magic + 100% AD physical damage on arrival.
During the Q dash, weave in R (Chum the Waters) toward the dummy so its 2s fuse starts as early as possible.
Immediately after the dash resolves, cast W (Seastone Trident) to arm the next basic attack.
Auto-attack to consume the W empower, dealing bonus magic damage, resetting the attack timer, and applying the passive bleed.
Cast E (Playful) and cancel it into Trickster as soon as it becomes available (~0.15s in) for the same splash damage but a faster resolution, letting its post-effect cooldown start sooner.
Fill all remaining time with basic attacks to keep the passive bleed refreshed and to consume any active on-hit buff window from W.
Recast Q, W, E/Trickster, and R on cooldown for the rest of the 15s window in that priority order (shortest cooldown first), interleaving auto-attacks between casts.
Track mana against the 15s window (Q 50, W 30-70, E 75-95, R 100) and fall back to auto-attacks plus lowest-cost Q/W if mana would otherwise run out.
